g.text: CATEGORIES — FILL COLOUR ENCODES THE OPERATION CATEGORY, NOTHING ELSE
SHAPES — OUTLINE ENCODES THE KIND OF ELEMENT
EDGES — ONE SOLID STYLE FOR DATA FLOW, DISTINCT STYLES FOR OTHER MEANINGS
tensor shape on the edge (C×H×W, batch omitted)
folded recurrence: ■ marks the one-step delay
GROUPING — A FRAME IS ONE MODULE; THE BADGE COUNTS ITS REPETITIONS
